text:
taya: Heads-up: coffee beans are almost gone in the grinder canister. I opened it and its basically dust. Whoever bought the last bag pls reveal yourself. :eyes:
devon: Guilty. Bought the dark roast last month. I thought there was another bag in the cabinet. My bad 
lee: This is the third time this quarter weve run low. Can we put a small communal tab for staples? $10/month each and we rotate who shops.
nina: +1 to communal tab. Also can we add a decaf option? I cant handle the espresso after 3pm. :sleeping:
taya: Decaf yes. Maybe split beanstash: 1 dark, 1 medium, 1 decaf. And a separate oat/almond milk fund.
pantry-bot: New suggestion recorded: "bean-rotation + non-dairy fund". Create poll? React with :+1: to support.
devon: Poll: what bean mix for this week? 1) Dark roast 2) House medium 3) Decaf 4) Single-origin espresso
lee: 2 and 3 for the win. Also pinging @nina, want to volunteer to pick up beans today at 4pm?
nina: I can grab them on my way home if someone puts $5 in Venmo to the pantry kitty. Ill buy two 12oz bags: medium + decaf.
taya: I'll Venmo $5. Also note: sugar packets are low and the french press cleaner is missing. If you used it, please return.
pantry-bot: Shopping list generated:
```
- beans: medium roast (12oz)
- beans: decaf (12oz)
- oat milk 1L
- sugar packets x1 box
- french press cleaner (if not found, replace)
```
(This is an automated pantry reminder.)
devon: Thanks @nina! Can you snag a small bag of biscotti if it's in stock? Last box was glorious. :cookie:
lee: Also, label jars please. Someone put cinnamon in the cacao jar last week and the chai was... surprising. :grimacing:
taya: Agreed on labeling. I'll print a few sticky labels and tape tomorrow morning. Tiny suggestion: keep an expiry sticky for opened jars (date + initials).
nina: Cool, returning the empty grinder canister now and will drop the beans by the espresso station at ~17:30. I'll add a little note "beans refilled by nina 03/22".
pantry-bot: Reminder: if you add non-reusable items, update the shared spreadsheet: tinyurl.com/pantry-ops. Ticket created for french press cleaner if not found.
devon: Legend move, appreciate the quick response. :sparkles: If anyone wants to be on the rotation list, say so and Ill add you.
lee: Put me down for April week 2.
taya: Me for April week 3.
nina: Done. See you at espresso o'clock. :coffee:
